user.title: Codex Assist
user.description: Sign in with your ChatGPT/Codex account first. You will choose a chat model from your account’s model list after signing in.

device.title: Sign in with Codex

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in with Codex again
reauth_confirm.description: Codex Assist needs a fresh ChatGPT/Codex sign-in. Continue to request a new device code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Codex Assist
reconfigure.description: Sign in again with your ChatGPT/Codex account. Your Codex Assist options will stay unchanged.

model.title: Choose a chat model
model.description: {model_status} Select the model used for Assist conversations and AI Task requests. Availability and feature support can vary by account.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Codex Assist was reconfigured and signed in again.

error.authorization_pending: That code has not been approved yet. Finish signing in in your browser, wait a few seconds, then continue again.
error.device_code_auth_failed: Codex sign-in failed. Restart setup and try again.
error.device_code_request_failed: Could not request a Codex device code. Check network access from Home Assistant and try again.
error.invalid_model: Choose a model from the displayed list.
error.no_models: Your account returned no visible models. Try again later or restart setup with another account.

init.title: Codex Assist options
init.description:
{model_status}

Start with the everyday settings. Advanced chat and image-generation defaults stay collapsed until you need them. Device control still follows Home Assistant’s Assist exposed-entity settings.

data_description.model: The model used for Assist conversations and AI Task requests.
data_description.text_verbosity: How concise or detailed normal text and voice responses should be.
data_description.web_search: Allow the model to search the web for current information. Search is off by default.

data_description.prompt: Standing instructions applied to Assist conversations.
data_description.reasoning_effort: How much reasoning supported models should use before answering.

data_description.image_model: Default quality for images created through Home Assistant AI Task.
data_description.image_size: Default shape and resolution for generated images.

error.invalid_model: Choose a listed model or keep your saved model.
